name: Specify
description: Initialize a new spec-driven development project using the Specify CLI tool. This task sets up the project structure, templates, and AI assistant configuration for spec-driven development.
author: Spec Kit Team

inputs.name: projectName
inputs.label: Project Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name for the spec-driven development project. Defaults to the repository name.

inputs.name: projectPath
inputs.label: Project Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path where the project will be initialized. Defaults to the build sources directory.

inputs.name: aiAssistant
inputs.label: AI Assistant
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the AI assistant to use for spec-driven development.

inputs.name: scriptType
inputs.label: Script Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the script type for the project (PowerShell for Windows, Bash for Linux/macOS).

inputs.name: specifyVersion
inputs.label: Specify CLI Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of the Specify CLI to use. Use 'latest' for the most recent version.

inputs.name: skipGit
inputs.label: Skip Git Initialization
inputs.helpMarkDown: Skip git repository initialization if already in a git repository.

inputs.name: ignoreAgentTools
inputs.label: Ignore Agent Tools Check
inputs.helpMarkDown: Skip checks for AI agent tools like Claude Code or Gemini CLI.
